license: Original code and fixtures authored for this evaluation, except assets/amd64-module.bin: that file is _uuid.pyd taken unmodified from the Python 3.12.9 Windows embeddable distribution (python-3.12.9-embed-amd64.zip), distributed under the Python Software Foundation License Version 2 and bundled here as a read-only sample image.
lineage: Windows procurement requirement -> expert-constructed wpeimg PE-image behaviour contract -> offline authoritative checksum capture through imagehlp!MapFileAndCheckSumW -> local base/oracle differential calibration -> container control runs
pollution_risk: Low. The subject is the on-disk structure of Windows portable executable images: optional-header layout selection, section-table placement, RVA-to-file-offset translation, structural self-consistency and the Windows image checksum fold. It does not overlap the other Windows tasks in this batch (wacl, wads, wchunk, wencoding, wfmt, winstall, wpathext, wpipe, wport, wproc, wps, wreg, wreparse, wreserved, wrotate, wscan, wstamp, wsync, wtask), which cover ACLs, alternate data streams, chunked containers, encoding, formatting, installers, PATHEXT, pipes, ports, processes, PowerShell modules, registry, reparse points, reserved device names, log rotation, directory scanning, timestamps, sync and task scheduling. The two sample images are shipped bytes rather than generated fixtures, so no fixture generator is shared with any other task.
authorization: No external repository is included. The only third-party artefact is the PSF-licensed Python binary named above, used unmodified as a read-only sample; everything else is original. No network access is required to build or grade the task.
